defs.def: to lift or move sth to a higher level 提升；举起；提起

ex.s: Whaley got the idea of this second-grade presidential campaign project when he asked the children one day to raise their hands if they thought they could never be a president.
ex.t: 有一天，惠利问孩子们：如果觉得自己永远当不上总统就举手。他由此萌生了开展这个二年级“总统竞选”项目的想法。

ex.s: In roughly 15 minutes, the movers inflated the airbags to about three feet in diameter to raise the root ball to the surface of the hole.
ex.t: 大约15分钟内，搬运工把气囊充到约3英尺直径，把根球抬到坑面。

ex.s: raised memory capacity
ex.t: 提升记忆容量。

defs.def: to move sth/sb/yourself to a vertical position （使）直立，站立

ex.s: The elephant was found to either use suction at a fixed distance from the pancake to "raise” the object in the air and hold it, or gently press the tip of its trunk against the pancake and apply suction to pick it up.
ex.t: 研究发现，大象要么在离煎饼固定距离处使用吸力把物体抬到空中并吸住，要么轻轻把象鼻尖压在煎饼上施加吸力把它捡起。

ex.s: They raise the local temperature slowly.
ex.t: 它们使当地气温缓慢上升。

ex.s: This is how everyone learned to read． We would start off with sentences， then paragraphs， and then stories． It seemed an unending journey， but even as a six﹣year﹣old girl I realized that knowing how to read could open many doors． When mom said， "The C﹣A﹣N﹣D﹣Y is hidden on the top shelf，" I knew where the candy was． My progress in reading raised my curiosity， and I wanted to know everything． I often found myself telling my mom to drive more slowly， so that I could read all of the road signs we passed．
ex.t: 每个人都是这样学会阅读的。我们从句子开始，然后是段落，再然后是故事。这似乎是一段永无止境的旅程，但即使作为一个六岁的女孩，我也意识到学会阅读能打开许多扇门。当妈妈说：“C-A-N-D-Y藏在最上面的架子上”时，我知道糖果在哪里。我在阅读上的进步激发了我的好奇心，我想知道一切。我经常叫妈妈开慢一点，这样我就能读出我们路过的所有路标。

defs.def: to increase the amount or level of sth 增加，提高（数量、水平等）

ex.s: Best of all, humor raises your energy, and that can have an effect on everything you do at school, at work, or in your personal life.
ex.t: 最好的是，幽默可以提高你的能量，这可以影响你在学校，工作或个人生活中所做的一切。

ex.s: To raise the quality of electric cars.
ex.t: 为了提高电动汽车的质量。

ex.s: Offer their staff a salary raise.
ex.t: 给员工加薪。

ex.s: To help raise the crew's pay.
ex.t: 帮助提高剧组人员的薪酬。

ex.s: They raised the prices of their products.
ex.t: 它们削减了产量。

ex.s: To help raise the crew’s pay.
ex.t: 帮助提高剧组人员的薪酬。

ex.s: Focusing on what you do raises productivity.
ex.t: 专注于你所做的事情能提高生产力。

ex.s: They raise the cortisol level.
ex.t: 它们会提高皮质醇水平。

ex.s: The increase of energy will even make you more willing to exercise, and that will raise your overall energy even more.
ex.t: 精力的增加甚至会让你更愿意锻炼，而这会进一步提高你的整体精力水平。

ex.s: Earth Day，  4  （mark）on 22 April，is an annual event aiming to raise public awareness about environmental protection.
ex.t: 地球日，于4月22日___4___（mark），是一项旨在提高公众环保意识的年度活动。

ex.s: It raises people’s confidence.
ex.t: 它提高人们的信心。

ex.s: There are lots of ways to raise awareness for a cause.
ex.t: 有很多方式可以提高对某项事业的认识。

ex.s: This is why Campbell has set out to raise awareness of AI and its future now — several decades before these developments are expected to take place.
ex.t: 这就是为什么坎贝尔现在就开始提高人们对人工智能及其未来的认识——比这些发展预计发生的时间早了几十年。

defs.def: to bring or collect money or people together; to manage to get or form sth 筹募；征集；召集；组建

ex.s: To raise money for local artists.
ex.t: 为本地艺术家筹款。

ex.s: To raise money for medical research.
ex.t: 为医学研究筹集资金。

ex.s: To raise money for his company.
ex.t: 为他的公司筹款。

ex.s: Raising money for a poor girl
ex.t: 舞蹈提醒我还活着。"

ex.s: To raise money for animal protection.
ex.t: 为动物保护筹款。

ex.s: Most of the organisers are volunteers and much of the money raised from ticket sales goes to charity.
ex.t: 大多数组织者都是志愿者，门票销售筹集的大部分资金都捐给了慈善机构。

defs.def: to mention sth for people to discuss or sb to deal with 提及；提起（课题）

ex.s: To raise a question.
ex.t: 为了提出一个问题。

ex.s: This raised the larger question of rereading.
ex.t: 这引出了关于重读的更大问题。

ex.s: To raise a question.
ex.t: 为了提出一个问题。

defs.def: to cause or produce sth; to make sth appear 引起；导致；使出现

ex.s: Visitor data collection also raises privacy issues.
ex.t: 参观者数据的收集也引发了隐私问题。

ex.s: How personal stories raise doubts.
ex.t: 个人故事如何引发疑虑。

ex.s: In some cases, it’s not so much the treatment of the animals on set in the studio that has activists worried; it’s the off-set training and living conditions that are raising concerns.
ex.t: 在某些情况下，让活动家担心的不一定是摄影棚内动物的待遇问题；而是场外的训练和生活条件引发了担忧。

ex.s: Scientists are still trying to determine how harmful microplastics are — but what they do know has raised concerns.
ex.t: 科学家们仍在试图确定微塑料到底有多有害——但他们目前已知的已经引发了担忧。

defs.def: to care for a child or young animal until it is able to take care of itself 抚养；养育；培养

ex.s: In the study, about 52 percent of the dads exhibited above-average levels of authoritative parenting. key finding is that over time, children raised by an authoritative father were significantly more likely to develop persistence, which leads to better outcomes in school.
ex.t: 在这项研究中，约52%的父亲表现出高于平均水平的权威型育儿方式。关键发现是，随着时间的推移，由权威型父亲抚养的孩子明显更有可能培养出毅力，从而在学校取得更好的成绩。

ex.s: raise their children in London
ex.t: 在伦敦抚养他们的孩子

ex.s: His parents had raised the 12-year-old to be a good boy.
ex.t: 他的父母把这位12岁的孩子教养成为一个好男孩。

ex.s: What would an authoritative father do when raising his children?
ex.t: 权威型父亲在抚养孩子时会怎么做？

ex.s: Jenn Berman, author of The A to Z Guide to Raising Happy and Confident Kids, says, "We've gone to the opposite extreme of a few decades ago when parents tended to be more strict." By giving kids a lot of praise, parents think they're building their children's confidence, when, in fact, it may be just the opposite.
ex.t: 《培养快乐自信孩子A到Z指南》的作者Jenn Berman说："我们已经走到了几十年前父母往往更严厉的那个极端的对立面。"通过给孩子很多表扬，父母以为在建立孩子的自信，而实际上可能适得其反。

defs.def: to breed particular farm animals; to grow particular crops 饲养；培育；种植

ex.s: Last winter when I went here again, they had a big separate house to raise dozens of chicken.
ex.t: 去年冬天我再去了一次，他们有了一间独立的大屋，养了几十只鸡。

ex.s: help to raise worms
ex.t: 帮忙养蚯蚓。

defs.def: to end a restriction on sb/sth 终止，解除（约束）
to contact sb and speak to them by radio or telephone （通过无线电或电话）与 … 取得联系，和 … 通话

ex.s: However, a strong smell is added so that we can raise the alarm when we detect the smell associated with danger.
ex.t: 然而，会加入一种强烈的气味，这样当我们察觉到与危险相关的气味时就能发出警报。

ex.s: I was born and raised in Cleveland, Ohio in the United States.
ex.t: 由于配对过程涉及许多因素，并非所有报名的学生都能匹配到搭档并能够注册参与本项目。

ex.s: What did the author think of raising the tiger cubs at home?
ex.t: 作者为什么决定把斑点和条纹送回动物园？

ex.s: He and I were raised here in New York, just like two brothers, together.
ex.t: 他和我都是在纽约这里长大的，就像两兄弟一样，形影不离。

ex.s: We were raised on books and computers, highways and cell phones, but now we were living in a village without running water or electricity It was easy for us to go to sleep at the end of the day feeling a little misunderstood.
ex.t: 我们是在书本、电脑、高速公路和手机的环境中长大的，但现在却住在一个没有自来水和电的村庄。一天结束时，我们带着一点不被理解的感觉入睡是很容易的事。

ex.s: When this takes place, especially when a new-born company has no revenue to speak of, the regulators should raise red flags.
ex.t: 当这种情况发生时，尤其是一家新生公司还谈不上有什么收入时，监管机构应该亮起红灯。

ex.s: It has raised over ￡2 million for gorilla conservation and poverty reduction projects in Central Africa ·The Gorilla Organization works on gorilla conservation projects in Rwanda, Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo.
ex.t: 它为中非的大猩猩保护和扶贫项目筹集了超过200万英镑·大猩猩组织在中非的卢旺达、乌干达和刚果民主共和国开展大猩猩保护项目。

to make a higher bet than another player in a card game 在（另一玩牌人）基础上加注

ex.s: Each dish was tailor-made to raise awareness regarding food waste.
ex.t: 两年后，即在怀俄明州建州之前的18年，黄石成为了美国乃至世界上第一个国家公园。

ex.s: Since early 2020, Ms Young has raised money to buy meals from Chinatown restaurants and deliver them to those in need.

ex.s: This is a programme run by The Gorilla Organization to raise money to save the world’s last remaining gorillas from dying out.
ex.t: 这是大猩猩保护组织运营的一个项目，旨在筹集资金以拯救世界上仅存的大猩猩免于灭绝。

ex.s: They also had a small pond, which they raised fish.
ex.t: 他们还有一个小池塘，他们在里面养鱼。
